stem: Differentiate between basic literacy and digital literacy.
modelAnswer: Basic literacy is the ability to read and write text. Digital literacy is the broader ability to find, evaluate, use and create information using digital devices and tools, including basic literacy as one component.

stem: Suggest strategies for integrating digital literacy into computer graphics.
modelAnswer: Teach students to research and evaluate source material online before designing, use digital design tools (image editors, presentation software) to create graphics, and have students critically review published graphics for accuracy and design quality.

stem: Describe the role of books in verifying information for academic purposes.
modelAnswer: Published, peer-reviewed or editorially-vetted books provide a more reliably fact-checked source than many websites, so they are used to cross-check and verify facts found online before citing them in academic work.

stem: Discuss the relationship between communication, collaboration, and digital literacy.
modelAnswer: Digital literacy includes the skills to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively using digital tools (video calls, shared documents, messaging); strong digital literacy improves both communication and collaboration, while communication/collaboration needs also drive people to build digital literacy skills.

stem: Do you think that X (Twitter) plays a vital role in opinion making about any social issue? Support your answer with three arguments.
modelAnswer: Yes. (1) It lets news and opinions spread instantly to a very large audience. (2) It allows direct interaction between public figures, journalists and ordinary users, shaping discourse in real time. (3) Trending hashtags can rapidly build momentum and visibility around a social issue, influencing public opinion and even policy attention.

stem: Outline effective strategies for identifying and countering online disinformation.
modelAnswer: Check the source's credibility and cross-verify claims with multiple reputable sources, look for the original context of images/quotes before sharing, and use fact-checking websites; countering it means not resharing unverified claims and reporting clear disinformation to the platform.

stem: Differentiate between poster designing and billboard designing.
modelAnswer: A poster is typically viewed up close and can include more detail and text, while a billboard is viewed briefly from a distance (often by moving traffic), so it must use large, simple visuals and minimal text to grab attention quickly.

stem: Define social media and describe the significance of YouTube and Facebook.
modelAnswer: Social media refers to digital platforms that let users create, share and interact with content and each other. YouTube is significant as the leading platform for video content, tutorials and entertainment; Facebook is significant for personal networking, community groups and business marketing/marketplace features.

stem: Explain the role of information collection in the field of digital literacy.
modelAnswer: Information collection is the starting point of digital literacy because a person needs relevant information before communicating or publishing ideas. Information can be collected from books, websites, videos, surveys and other sources. The collected information is then evaluated, organized and converted into clear digital content for a target audience.
keyPoints: ["Information collection is the starting point of digital literacy: gathering data/facts from digital sources before it can be evaluated or used.","It requires the skill to identify credible sources (websites, surveys, forms) and use appropriate digital tools to gather relevant information efficiently.","Good information collection underpins every later digital literacy skill, since evaluation, communication and content creation all depend on having accurate raw information to start from."]

stem: Analyze the key components of digital literacy and their significance.
modelAnswer: The key components are digital search and information literacy, technical skills, communication, collaboration, digital content creation, and ethics and responsibility. Search literacy helps a learner find, understand and evaluate information. Technical skills enable the use of devices and software. Communication and collaboration support clear, respectful work with others. Content creation turns ideas into posters, videos, presentations or other digital products. Ethics and responsibility require respect for cultural, social and religious differences and responsible sharing.
keyPoints: ["Information collection: gathering data from digital sources.","Technical skills: using digital devices/software competently.","Communication and collaboration: expressing ideas and working with others using digital tools.","Digital content creation: producing text, graphics, video or other media.","Ethics and responsibility: using digital tools and information responsibly and respecting cultural/social boundaries.","Together these components let a person function effectively and responsibly in a digital-first world."]

stem: Define information extraction and its purpose.
modelAnswer: Information extraction is the process of identifying the main points that are most relevant to a purpose from collected data. It requires understanding the material, focusing on key information, evaluating its relevance and reliability, and then presenting the selected ideas clearly to an audience.
keyPoints: ["Information extraction is the process of identifying and pulling out the most important, relevant facts from a larger body of information.","Its purpose is to filter out unnecessary detail so that only the key ideas needed for a task (e.g. a report, a presentation, a poster) remain.","This makes the information easier to understand, summarize and present to an audience."]

stem: Illustrate the use of images and graphics in billboard design.
modelAnswer: Images and graphics make a billboard attractive and help communicate its message quickly to people who are on the move. A billboard should have a clear purpose, a highlighted key message, coordinated text, logo, colours and pictures, and a balance between text and graphics. The pictures should support the message instead of overshadowing it, and the design should remain simple, legible and appropriate for the target audience.
keyPoints: ["Billboards rely heavily on large, simple, high-contrast images since they are viewed briefly, often by moving traffic.","Graphics are used to instantly communicate the core message (a product, a brand, an event) without requiring the viewer to read much text.","Effective billboard graphics balance color, size and placement so the image is legible and impactful from a distance and at speed."]

stem: Discuss the impact of social media on contemporary communication, referencing YouTube and WhatsApp as examples.
modelAnswer: Social media is an effective contemporary communication tool for audio and video calls, sharing information and reaching audiences. Businesses use it to reach customers and promote products, while users share content and communicate with others. YouTube supports worldwide video sharing, learning, entertainment and marketing. WhatsApp is a digital communication tool used for messaging and sharing information, so both platforms can connect people and distribute content quickly. Users should share authentic, reliable content because social media can also spread misinformation and disinformation.
keyPoints: ["Social media has shifted communication from primarily one-to-one to one-to-many and community-based interaction.","YouTube lets creators broadcast video content to a global audience, changing how people learn and are entertained.","WhatsApp enables instant, low-cost group messaging and calling across distances, replacing much traditional SMS/phone communication.","Together these platforms have made communication faster, more visual, and more globally connected, though also raising concerns about privacy and misinformation."]
